ribfrac:RibFrac93: VERIDAH names 13 vertebrae between C7 and L1 at regular spacing. TotalSegmentator's objects miss one near T6-T7 and split one at T11/T12, so B's object count is not a vertebra count here. The 13th vertebra carries one short rib (TotalSegmentator's right rib 12, about 5 cm) and only a small process on the other side. It is 13 rib-bearing counted from the first rib-bearing vertebra if that short rib is a rib. C1-C5 are not in the field (a cervical rib is not excluded by count) and the scan ends at L3, so T13 vs a rib on L1 is open.
ribfrac:RibFrac101: 13 rib levels from the first rib-bearing vertebra (VERIDAH T1-T13). The 13th carries a long rib on one side and a short one (about 4-5 cm) on the other. TotalSegmentator's objects 8-10 span VERIDAH's T5-T8 (one vertebra missing), which is why B counts 12. The strongest T13 candidate of the four. C1-C4 are not in the field and the scan ends at L3, so T13 (25 presacral) vs a rib on L1 (24) is open.
ribfrac:RibFrac322: VERIDAH T1-T13 at regular spacing; TotalSegmentator misses one vertebra at T7-T9 (12 objects over 13 vertebrae). The 13th vertebra carries short stubs on both sides (roughly 3-4 cm): T13 by the rib count, a lumbar rib on L1 by the VerSe 38 mm rule. The scan ends at L2.
ribfrac:RibFrac539: 12 long rib pairs on VERIDAH T1-T12 and short stubs (about 3 cm) on both sides of the 13th vertebra, which B leaves rib-free; TotalSegmentator merged T7 and T8 into one object. T13 by the rib count, lumbar rib by the 38 mm rule. The scan ends at L3.
ribfrac:RibFrac482: 12 rib pairs on T1-T12 (A and B agree one to one). VERIDAH names six bodies below T12 at regular 31-35 mm spacing; TotalSegmentator merged two lumbar bodies (its object 18 spans VERIDAH L3-L4). The field ends at the sixth body with the sacrum only at the edge, so whether that body is an L6 or the top of the sacrum cannot be seen. A genuine 25-presacral candidate that a longer field would settle.
ctspine1k:MSD-T10/liver_119: 11 rib pairs on T1-T11 counted from the first rib-bearing vertebra (C5-C7 above, rib-free), then six rib-free bodies to the sacrum, each with a disc. 24 presacral if the top is C5: a rib-less 12th thoracic vertebra, which the CTSpine1K annotation names T12 (12 + 5). L6 by the rib convention only, not a supernumerary segment. B's cage span 12 includes a spurious TotalSegmentator object between T6 and T7, and its sixth lumbar body comes from a merged object (L3+L4).
ctspine1k:MSD-T10/liver_95: Same as liver_119: 11 rib pairs to T11, six rib-free bodies to the sacrum, 24 presacral; the annotation names the rib-less body T12. L6 by the rib convention only. B's span includes a duplicate TotalSegmentator object at T7, and its sixth lumbar body comes from a merged object.
ctspine1k:MSD-T10/liver_106: VERIDAH names 18 bodies C7-L5 at regular spacing and puts the next segment in the sacrum. The CTSpine1K annotation labels 19 (C7-L6) and its README lists the scan under 'Sacral Lumbarization', so the extra segment is at the lumbosacral junction, which neither labeller separates. B's L6 is a signature (TotalSegmentator merged T11 and T12 into one object), not a sixth body it drew. The row stays at the release read.
ctspine1k:MSD-T10/liver_83: Short stubs (about 3 cm) on the vertebra VERIDAH calls T12, long ribs on T11, then four rib-free bodies and the sacrum, as VERIDAH and the annotation (4 lumbar ids, README sacralisation) say. B's 'normal' comes from a spurious TotalSegmentator object at T11/T12 and an unattached stub. If the T12 stubs were called lumbar ribs (38 mm rule), the count would read 11 + 5.
ctspine1k:MSD-T10/liver_93: 12 rib pairs to T12, then four rib-free bodies and the sacrum, as VERIDAH and the annotation say. B's five comes from two TotalSegmentator objects on one body (L1).
carmlspine:case42: Lumbar CBCT: five mobile bodies that VERIDAH names L2-L6 under a partial top body, then the sacrum. The lowest mobile segment has broad transverse processes against the ala (a transitional segment). No rib head in the field, so L6 vs a transitional L5 cannot be counted.
carmlspine:case121: Five mobile bodies (VERIDAH L2-L6) under a partial top body, each with a disc. Only a lateral rib tip at the field edge, no rib head. The count depends on whether the partial top body is L1 or T12, and that is not in the field.
carmlspine:case136: Five mobile bodies (L2-L6) under a partial body. Lateral tips of the 11th/12th ribs at the top corners, no rib head. The lowest mobile segment is wedge-shaped with broad transverse processes. No count.
carmlspine:case134: Four mobile bodies (L2-L5), then the sacrum. VERIDAH's L6 point lies 7 mm below its L5 on the same body: not a vertebra. Dropped by the variant-on-neighbour guard.
ribfrac:RibFrac8: Thick slices; not resolved on this render. B's first rib-bearing object is VERIDAH's T2 (VERIDAH's T1 is cyan), so the discordance is whether the first rib is attached to T1. If it is, B also counts 13 rib-bearing vertebrae and agrees with A's T13. The lowest ribs (TotalSegmentator's 12th) sit at VERIDAH's T13 level.
ribfrac:RibFrac100: B's 13 comes from TotalSegmentator's first rib attached to the vertebra VERIDAH names C7 (B's object 2): the rib head lies at the C7/T1 disc. VERIDAH's 12 thoracic with the 12th ribs on T12 matches the render. A cervical rib is not excluded, but nothing on the render suggests one. Likely normal.
ribfrac:RibFrac55: VERIDAH's 12 is right on the render: T12 carries short 12th ribs (about 3 cm, both sides) that B did not attach, and B's mid-cage hole at T10 is an unattached rib. B's 11 is a B miss (hypoplastic 12th ribs), not an 11-rib spine.
carmlspine:case101: The field starts with a cut T12 (a 14 mm sliver) whose 12th ribs run into the top corners. B attached them to the whole vertebra below (TotalSegmentator's L1), which made its four-lumbar count. The rib-bearing reference is not whole in the field, so there is no count (the reference-at-edge guard now refuses it). VERIDAH names the five whole bodies L2-L6.
ctspine1k:MSD-T10/liver_104: 12 rib pairs on VERIDAH T1-T12 (TotalSegmentator ribs 1-12). VERIDAH's 'T13' carries no rib on the render, and five lumbar bodies follow before the sacrum: six rib-free bodies between the last rib and the sacrum, 25 presacral if the top is C7. This is the TS s1088/s1123 pattern (a rib-less 20th vertebra that VERIDAH names T13), an L6 by the rib convention. B's own count is broken (a duplicate object at T8, TotalSegmentator's object 13 spans VERIDAH T13+L1).
ribfrac:RibFrac377: Both labellers' 'four lumbar' is a field-edge artefact: the chest CT ends at L5, and VERIDAH's 'S' point and TotalSegmentator's sacrum sit on the last few slices (VERIDAH S 3.7 mm from the edge, TotalSegmentator sacrum 11 mm long). The sacrum-at-edge guard now refuses the lumbosacral count. 12 rib pairs on T1-T12.
